title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 27 February 2026 Mainly fair weather will prevail over the most parts of the island. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura and Monaragala districts after 2.00 p.m. Misty conditions can be expected at several places in the island during the early hours of the morning.
